How to rotate

Rotation process

  1. Remove the burned domain from the campaign in SmartLead (swap out the email accounts assigned to it).
  2. Let the burned domain rest for at least 4 to 6 weeks before attempting to re-use it. Do not send cold email from it during this time.
  3. Pick a reserve domain that has completed warm-up. Add its mailboxes to the campaign in SmartLead.
  4. Check this report again in 7 days to confirm the replacement domain is getting replies.
  5. If a vendor is consistently supplying burned domains, flag it with them and ask for replacements.
